notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Everything should work now :) I will now work on mouse support and UI changes



Fixes:

Achievements should work as intended

Game loading works correctly even on different levels

New features:

Special words, that give you extra effects when written correctly

Curse rooms, where you sacrifice good things to get even better things

A lot of little UI and game-play improvements
